bot.name: Interior Design Sales Consultant
bot.description: Automation-first interior design and services assistant that captures requirements, estimates budget ranges from maintained pricing records, collects floor plans and references, recommends packages, books consultations, and supports quote, project, payment, and service lookups from persisted records.
bot.headerTagline: Design enquiry, estimate, consultation, and project support

messages.text: Welcome! I can help with interior requirements, cost estimates, packages, portfolio references, consultation booking, and post-sales support.
Choose a service or type your requirement directly.
{{package_catalog_text}}
Would you like an estimate or a consultation next?
Tell me the style, property type, or room you want to explore. Example: modern 3 BHK living room.

data.introText: Here are some relevant interior references.

messages.text: I could not find a close portfolio match from the current catalog, but I can still prepare an estimate or book a consultation using your requirement.
What would you like to do next?
Ask about materials, brands, finishes, or warranty. Example: Do you use Hettich? or Plywood vs MDF?
{{material_answer_text}}
